tagline: A diversified mining company with a balanced portfolio across diamonds, precious metals, and bulk commodities
hero_kpi_rationale: The Diamonds segment, driven by the De Beers acquisition, is a strategic differentiating driver within the mining portfolio, featuring an iconic brand and a global leadership position in the diamond market. Optimized inventory management (reduction from $2.3 Bn to $1.8 Bn) demonstrates improved operational efficiency.
company_description: Anglo American plc, a mining company, produces copper, iron ore, and crop nutrients in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company operates through the Premium Iron Ore and the Copper segments. It also explores for nickel, diamonds, steelmaking coal, and manganese ore. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

kpis.name: De Beers - Strategic Portfolio and Inventory Management
kpis.explanation: Management of the De Beers portfolio including optimization of rough diamond inventory and related assets.
kpis.description: De Beers rough diamond inventory and related assets reduced to approximately $1.8 billion, down from $2.3 billion at end-2024, reflecting normalization of working capital levels.
kpis.signal: Strategic inventory optimization toward De Beers' normalized levels.

kpis.name: Metallurgical Coal - Divestment in Progress
kpis.explanation: Ongoing sale of the metallurgical coal portfolio to Peabody Energy, including the Moranbah and Grosvenor mines.
kpis.description: Monthly care and maintenance costs of approximately $45 million for Moranbah and $10 million for Grosvenor, totaling around $250 million semi-annually, reflecting the standstill period for longwall operations pending restart.
kpis.signal: Care and maintenance costs during the operational transition and restart phase.

kpis.name: Collahuasi Copper - Accelerated Stripping Program
kpis.explanation: Additional investments to accelerate mining stripping and resolve crushed ore and water constraints.
kpis.description: Additional costs of approximately $480 million in H1 2025 for accelerated stripping and enhanced mining equipment, aimed at mitigating bottlenecks related to stockpile ore quality and water constraints through end-2026.
kpis.signal: Temporary cost increase to improve operational flexibility and production recovery.

kpis.name: Serpentina - Iron Ore Deposit Development
kpis.explanation: The Serpentina project in Brazil aims to replace Minas Rio ore with a softer ore body of equivalent grade.
kpis.description: The Serpentina project will replace harder ore expected in the mid-30s with an equivalent or slightly higher-grade ore body available earlier. This substitution would avoid approximately $2 billion in capex for reinforcing crushing and grinding at existing plants.
kpis.signal: Strategic substitution generating approximately $2 billion in capex savings by avoiding capacity upgrades in crushing/grinding.

risks.title: Operational Safety and Fatal Incidents
risks.summary: Anglo American faces significant risks of fatalities and serious injuries in its mining operations. In 2012, 13 employees died in work-related accidents. The S&SD Committee regularly reviews each fatal incident and associated management responses, covering critical areas such as methane control, slope stability, and shaft integrity.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned: 13 work-related fatalities in 2012. Prominent presence in S&SD Committee discussions (each quarterly meeting). Serious language ("fatal incidents", "colleagues lost their lives"). Stable but persistent trend. Very high category weight for mining.

risks.title: Environmental Risks and Mine Stability
risks.summary: Anglo American manages complex environmental risks related to its mining operations, including slope stability, tailings management, and shaft integrity. The S&SD Committee receives detailed reports on these critical areas to prevent catastrophic failures that could impact local communities and the environment.
risks.score_rationale: Mining-specific risks explicitly discussed at S&SD Committee: slope stability, tailings risks, shaft integrity. Technical and detailed language indicating active management. Stable trend with continuous monitoring. High category weight for mining operations.

risks.title: Dependence on Major Projects and Valuation Risks
risks.summary: Anglo American is highly dependent on large development projects such as Minas-Rio in Brazil. The Audit Committee has reviewed in detail the valuation process of this project and its accounting implications. Risks include cost overruns, commissioning delays, and changes in market conditions affecting profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Minas-Rio project in Brazil mentioned as a major audit topic (valuation, accounting implications). Board visit in October 2012 for direct assessment. Language indicating complexity and materiality. Stable trend but subject to active monitoring. High category weight for mining group.

risks.title: Regulatory and Political Risks in Key Jurisdictions
risks.summary: Anglo American operates in complex jurisdictions with significant regulatory and political risks. The Board has met with the Governor of Minas Gerais State in Brazil and engages with Alaskan authorities regarding the Pebble project. Changes in government policy, local environmental requirements, and community tensions can affect permits and operations.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mentions: meetings with state governors in Brazil, engagement with Alaska government, Pebble project. Language indicating strategic importance of political relationships. Stable trend with active engagement. High category weight for globally operating miner.

risks.title: Mineral Reserve Risks and Accounting Estimates
risks.summary: Anglo American's mineral reserve and resource estimates are subject to significant revisions based on geological data and market conditions. The Audit Committee oversees a triennial independent audit plan of these critical estimates for asset valuation and operational planning.
risks.score_rationale: Audit Committee has reviewed significant changes in mineral reserve and resource estimates with a triennial audit plan. Technical language indicating materiality. Stable trend with regular oversight. Moderate but important category weight for valuation.

risks.title: Portfolio Structure Risks and Major Transactions
risks.summary: Anglo American manages major portfolio transactions and restructurings, including Codelco's option to acquire up to 49% of Anglo American Sur, a restructuring of the Platinum division, and De Beers arrangements. These operations present complex accounting, tax, and governance risks.
risks.score_rationale: Mentions of restructurings: Codelco option (49% Anglo American Sur), Platinum structure, De Beers. Audit Committee reviewed detailed accounting implications. Language indicating transaction complexity. Stable trend with ongoing transactions. Moderate category weight.

risks.title: Occupational Health and Work-Related Diseases
risks.summary: Anglo American must manage occupational health risks and work-related diseases in its mining operations, including exposure to dust, noise, and infectious diseases such as HIV/AIDS. The S&SD Committee receives regular reports on health performance and prevention programs.
risks.score_rationale: Occupational health mentioned regularly in S&SD Committee quarterly reports. Explicit reference to HIV/AIDS as a monitoring topic. Language indicating systematic management. Stable trend with established programs. Moderate category weight for mining sector.

risks.title: Management Succession and Talent Retention Risks
risks.summary: Anglo American depends on the retention and development of key managerial talent. The Nomination Committee oversees succession planning at ExCo level and long-term talent management. The CEO transition in 2012 and ongoing search for qualified directors reflect the importance of this management.
risks.score_rationale: Nomination Committee managed CEO succession (Cynthia Carroll replaced by Mark Cutifani) and search for NEDs. Language indicating rigorous process. Stable trend with active planning. Moderate category weight for complex group.

events.title: Anglo American Continues Portfolio Optimization, Backs Guidance
events.body: The London-listed miner is focusing on copper and premium iron ore, and has plans to offload its steelmaking coal and diamond businesses.
